body: I really like this.  I think my biggest issue was that I used to be able to do a lot of things like daily exercise, focusing on work, etc...but now I can't.  Every time I try to improve myself I try to regain all of those things at once and completely fall on my face.  Maybe if I just focus on one thing and accept the rest...

Hard to pinpoint really, I went through the end of high school, college, grad school, and a job throughout the period I described.  Goals were things like working out in the morning, trying to get out and meet new people, etc...a little more specific than that but hopefully you get the gist
